name: Extravagant Order: the in-world turn-in diamond marks Tharynn Bouden, not Remy (#6465)
contract: Quest 17001 Extravagant Order starts and ends with Tharynn Bouden 66 (creature guid 80327 at -9494.13, 83.9096, 56.6586). The reporter's tracked diamond stood 11 yd away: the client resolves it from QuestSuperTrack.dbc row 40 (quest 17001), whose completion node 1080 sits at (-9496.32, 72.83, 56.6), Remy 'Two Times' 241's spawn and the completion node of his quest 47.

The login patch stream sends coa_client_quest_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_QUEST_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BF, 1727) and coa_client_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BE, 1726). Expected: row 40 is streamed whole with the client's objective 0 node 43 and completion node 21098, and node 21098 stands on Tharynn's spawn with the client's radius 5.5 and NextID 0; node 1080 stays unpatched.
These are data assertions on the bytes the server sends; the harness cannot see whether the client replaces its own row 40 or how it draws the diamond.

steps.label: SETUP: the character carries 17001 Extravagant Order complete, the way the reporter returned it
DISCRIMINATING: the login stream sends QuestSuperTrack row 40, the row of quest 17001, once
Objective 0 keeps the client's own Jasperlode Mine node 43
Objective 1 has no node, as in the client row
DISCRIMINATING: completion points at node 21098, where the client row has Remy's node 1080
The login stream sends SuperTrack node 21098 once
Node 21098 is on the Eastern Kingdoms, MapID 0
Node 21098 x is Tharynn Bouden's spawn -9494.13
Node 21098 y is Tharynn Bouden's spawn 83.9096, 11 yd from Remy's 72.83
Node 21098 z is Tharynn Bouden's spawn 56.6586
Node 21098 keeps the client's arrival radius of 5.5 yd
Remy's node 1080 is not patched, so quest 47 Gold Dust Exchange keeps its diamond on him
